observed_before_declaration: 8/36 prior trials complete; first open-minus teacher successful and first seven student trials unsuccessful
ranking: higher minimum whole-task successes across the two seeds
lower median per-trial p95 inference wall time
lower resolution then shorter history on exact tie
no_success_rule: If every student has zero whole-task successes, report no usable optimum; do not promote the least-bad failure as a solution.

confirmation.conditions: teacher, selected arm at both training seeds, 128-h1 baseline at both training seeds; deduplicate if selected baseline
confirmation.scope: same scene families with new small offsets; not general scene or physical robot evidence
confirmation.interpretation: Report screening selection and confirmation separately; a failed confirmation does not trigger tuning on these held-out cases.

cost: Record measured GPU/RAM peak, setup/training/evaluation wall time, per-decision latency, model hashes and unavailable compute-unit charges. No data/model/camera changes to rescue an arm during this screen.
cost_interpretation: Inference timings are observed under the fixed two-worker cohort and shared Mac load, not an isolated real-time guarantee. Latency is only a secondary tie-breaker after physical outcomes.
